f.m.progress: every 9 weeks with the report card
f.red[0].beh: Vocal disruption: calling out, screaming, or repeating a word at a volume above the classroom level for at least 3 s, or banging the desk with both hands. Not: answering when called on, singing during music.
f.red[0].cur: 1.2 per minute (EA-1 attention condition; 7.4 per 10-min seatwork on DD-1)
f.red[0].ctx: General education first grade with a push-in ESE teacher 60 min/day; 22 students
f.red[0].meth: a frequency count in every session, recorded on DD-1 by the classroom staff
f.acq[1].beh: ask while the signal shows the adult is available, and wait without asking while it shows the adult is busy
f.acq[1].cond: a visible signal (a colored card or a lanyard) showing when requests can be answered
f.acq[1].crit: with at least 90% of requests made while the "available" signal is on
f.acq[1].meth: requests during each signal counted on Form DD-1
f.acq[1].note: From the objective bank: Ask while the "available" signal is on, wait while it is off (Hanley et al., 2001; Tiger & Hanley, 2004; Cammilleri et al., 2008; Betz et al., 2013; Greer et al., 2016; Hagopian et al., 2011; Caruthers et al., 2015).
